questions.text: Price of pen, Pencils and Notebook sold in shop C is Rs. 15 Rs. 7 and Rs 39 respectively. Find the total revenue earned by the shop C?
questions.explanation:
Given:
Total items = Pen + Pencil + Notebook
Pen + Pencil = given
Pen − Pencil = given
Pen > Pencil

Shop A

⇒ Pen + Pencil = 48
⇒ Pen − Pencil = 8

⇒ Pen = (48 + 8) / 2 = 28
⇒ Pencil = (48 − 8) / 2 = 20

⇒ Notebook = 56 − 48 = 8

Shop B

⇒ Pen + Pencil = 26
⇒ Pen − Pencil = 2

⇒ Pen = (26 + 2) / 2 = 14
⇒ Pencil = (26 − 2) / 2 = 12

⇒ Notebook = 32 − 26 = 6

Shop C

⇒ Pen + Pencil = 44
⇒ Pen − Pencil = 4

⇒ Pen = (44 + 4) / 2 = 24
⇒ Pencil = (44 − 4) / 2 = 20

⇒ Notebook = 46 − 44 = 2

Shop D

⇒ Pen + Pencil = 25
⇒ Pen − Pencil = 5

⇒ Pen = (25 + 5) / 2 = 15
⇒ Pencil = (25 − 5) / 2 = 10

⇒ Notebook = 38 − 25 = 13

Shop E

⇒ Pen + Pencil = 38
⇒ Pen − Pencil = 2

⇒ Pen = (38 + 2) / 2 = 20
⇒ Pencil = (38 − 2) / 2 = 18

⇒ Notebook = 54 − 38 = 16

Calculation

⇒ Revenue from pens
⇒ 24 × 15 = 360

⇒ Revenue from pencils
⇒ 20 × 7 = 140

⇒ Revenue from notebooks
⇒ 2 × 39 = 78

⇒ Total revenue of Shop C
⇒ 360 + 140 + 78 = 578

∴ Total revenue earned by Shop C = ₹578

questions.text: Find the ratio of number of Jasmine plants planted on both days and number of Rose plants planted on both days.
questions.explanation:
Solution:

From the graph, we get:

Flower Plants Sunday Monday
Rose 12% of 2000 = 240 10% of 3000 = 300
Marigold 20% of 2000 = 400 25% of 3000 = 750
Sunflower 25% of 2000 = 500 24% of 3000 = 720
Lily 18% of 2000 = 360 16% of 3000 = 480
Jasmine 14% of 2000 = 280 12% of 3000 = 360
Hibiscus 11% of 2000 = 220 13% of 3000 = 390

Number of Jasmine plants planted on both days = (280 + 360) = 640

Number of Rose plants planted on both days = (240 + 300) = 540

Required ratio = 640 : 540 i.e., 32 : 27

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
